name: vault-mcp-connect
description: Session-start health check and status command for the Governor Obsidian bridge (plugin id 'governor'; historically 'vault-mcp') — warns when the mcp__governor__* (or legacy mcp__vault-mcp__*) tools will fail because Obsidian isn't serving the socket. Also ships the record-class write guard: PreToolUse hook refusing non-append Bash/MCP writes to 'Machinery record/' fold archives.
